description_expanded: This newly added vacation rental home is located just steps away from ZUMA. The main home offers a first-floor primary bedroom with one king-sized bed including a stackable washer and dryer. The first floor also offers an open concept dining and living room area adjacent to the kitchen. On the second floor you will find two additional bedrooms each with one king-sized bed and en suite bathrooms. There is an additional washer and dryer on this level as well. This home also features a private courtyard with open seating as well as a covered veranda with additional seating and an outdoor TV. The fourth bedroom with one king-sized bed resides in the carriage house above the 2-car garage. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
